criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies authorized common stock shortfall (100M vs 200M required)
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix item (i) and F-5 state Charter §4.1 authorizes 100,000,000 Common vs UA §6(j)(i) not fewer than 200,000,000.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cites correct documents/provisions for common stock shortfall
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites Charter §4.1 (100,000,000) and UA §6(j)(i) closing condition (200,000,000).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Rates authorized common stock shortfall as Critical severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix rates authorized capital item (i) 'Critical: amend' and F-5 is Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends increasing authorized common stock to at least 200M
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends drafting Fifth A&R Charter implementing §6(j)(i) (not fewer than 200,000,000 Common); matrix 'Critical: amend'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies preferred stock authorization mismatch (25M vs 10M)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Charter 25,000,000 Preferred vs UA/Prospectus 10,000,000 blank-check Preferred.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Cites correct figures for preferred stock mismatch
criteria_results.reasoning: Both figures, 25,000,000 and 10,000,000, correctly stated.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Rates preferred stock authorization mismatch as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Preferred authorization mismatch is rated Critical (matrix item (i), F-5), not High.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies surviving Series Preferred designations (A, B, C)
criteria_results.reasoning: F-5, matrix (ii) and F-20 identify surviving Series A/B/C terms (liquidation preferences, participation, anti-dilution) that UA §6(j)(ii) requires eliminated.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Notes anti-dilution/preferential rights must be eliminated
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (ii) and (x) note UA requires elimination of all preferential/anti-dilution rights that survive in the Charter.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Rates surviving series preferred designations as Critical
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (ii) rated 'Critical: delete §§4.4--4.7'; F-5 Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies missing federal forum provision for Securities Act claims
criteria_results.reasoning: F-5 and F-14 note Charter §8.1 Chancery-only forum with no federal forum provision, which UA §6(j)(vii) and Prospectus require.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Rates missing federal forum provision as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Federal forum/exclusive forum issue rated High in F-14 and matrix (vii).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies charter silence on director removal standard
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (iv) and F-5 note Charter silent on removal vs UA requirement of for-cause-only removal by 66 2/3%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Notes distinction between DGCL default rule and express requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Report only says DGCL §141(k) default is removal with or without cause; it does not address the classified-board for-cause default or explain why express language is still needed.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Rates director removal standard omission as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Removal standard rated Critical in matrix (iv), not High.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies written consent provision conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Charter §6.3 permits written consent vs UA prohibition after closing.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Rates written consent provision conflict as Critical
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (vi) rated Critical; F-5 Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies missing supermajority amendment threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Art. X simple majority vs UA 66 2/3% for classified board, removal, written consent, forum.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Specifies the 66⅔% supermajority threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Specifies 66 2/3%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies at least two of the four protected provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Lists all four protected provisions ((iii),(iv),(vi),(vii)).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Rates supermajority amendment threshold as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Supermajority item rated Critical in matrix (viii), not High.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies missing classified board structure
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Charter §5.3 annual election vs UA three-class staggered three-year terms.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Rates missing classified board as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Classified board rated Critical in matrix (iii), not High.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies DGCL Section 203 opt-out conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Charter Art. IX opt-out vs UA §6(j)(ix) requiring §203 to apply.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Rates Section 203 opt-out conflict as Critical
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (ix) rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends removing opt-out to allow Section 203 to apply
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends 'delete Art. IX' so §203 applies.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies lack of express cumulative voting prohibition
criteria_results.reasoning: Matrix (v): Charter silent; UA requires express prohibition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Acknowledges DGCL default but notes express requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes no cumulative voting by default under DGCL §214 yet recommends adding express clause per UA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Rates cumulative voting omission as Medium severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Cumulative voting rated High, not Medium.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies over-allotment share count discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: F-2 identifies Prospectus 1,500,000 vs UA 1,725,000.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Notes correct calculation is 1,725,000 (15% of 11,500,000)
criteria_results.reasoning: States UA figure is 15% x 11,500,000 = 1,725,000, market standard, and Prospectus understates full-exercise economics / sized on a different base.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Rates over-allotment discrepancy as Medium severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Over-allotment discrepancy rated Critical, not Medium.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies lock-up period trigger date discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: F-7 identifies Exhibit C running from UA date (Jan 6, 2025) vs 180 days after final Prospectus in UA body and Prospectus.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Notes potential early expiration risk from trigger date mismatch
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes lock-ups would expire about 8 days early, with closing-condition and disclosure risk.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Rates lock-up period discrepancy as High severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Lock-up trigger discrepancy rated Critical, not High.
